limitations: Decision indices are zero-based logical robot decisions, not physical controls or independent model response counts. Every observed original native coding call and its complete original output is included.
Shell execution outputs preserve the original combined stdout/stderr. Native JavaScript outputs have no operating-system exit code; no code is executed by this viewer or reviewer.
The post-terminal scratch directory is empty. Deleted files and unrecorded intermediate versions are not reconstructed or claimed recoverable.
All original paid attempts and transport segments remain separately accounted. Code inspection counts are not a claim of robot success or cost completeness.
No hidden reasoning, internal host metadata, credentials or absolute host paths are included. Original private source digests remain distinct from public content digests.
